basis: Written from early-primary science curriculum topics (Taiwan 國小自然 lower grades, NGSS K-2 and grade 3) BEFORE the failed questions were examined.

facts_zh: 水會把東西往上推，這個力叫浮力。
東西如果比同樣大小的水輕，就會浮起來。
東西如果比同樣大小的水重，就會沉下去。
有空氣的東西，像游泳圈、船，比較容易浮。
facts_en: Water pushes things up. This push is called buoyancy.
A thing that is lighter than the same amount of water floats.
A thing that is heavier than the same amount of water sinks.
Things with air inside, like swim rings and boats, float more easily.

facts_zh: 地球會把東西往下拉，這個力叫重力。
所以東西放手就會掉到地上。
重力把我們和所有東西留在地面上。
月亮上的重力比地球小，所以東西會變輕。
facts_en: The Earth pulls things down. This pull is called gravity.
That is why things fall to the ground when you let go.
Gravity keeps us and everything else on the ground.
The Moon pulls less than the Earth, so things feel lighter there.
applies_to_zh: 人在地球另一邊不會掉下去
applies_to_en: why we do not float away
people on the other side of the Earth

facts_zh: 兩個東西互相磨的時候，會有一種擋住動作的力，叫摩擦力。
粗粗的地方摩擦力大，滑滑的地方摩擦力小。
摩擦會讓東西變熱，也會讓滑動的東西慢慢停下來。
facts_en: When two things rub together, a force slows the movement. It is called friction.
Rough surfaces have more friction. Slippery surfaces have less.
Rubbing makes things warm, and it slowly stops sliding things.

facts_zh: 磁鐵會吸住有鐵的東西，像鐵釘和迴紋針。
磁鐵有兩端，一樣的兩端會推開，不一樣的兩端會吸在一起。
磁鐵不用碰到東西，也能拉住它。
不是所有東西都被磁鐵吸，像紙和塑膠就不會。
facts_en: A magnet pulls things made of iron, like nails and paper clips.
A magnet has two ends. Two of the same ends push apart, and two different ends pull together.
A magnet can pull a thing without touching it.
Not everything sticks to a magnet. Paper and plastic do not.

facts_zh: 東西一抖一抖（振動）就會發出聲音。
聲音會透過空氣傳到我們的耳朵。
抖得快，聲音就高；抖得慢，聲音就低。
東西抖得大力，聲音就大聲。
facts_en: When something shakes back and forth (vibrates), it makes a sound.
Sound travels through the air to our ears.
Fast shaking makes a high sound. Slow shaking makes a low sound.
Big shaking makes a loud sound.

facts_zh: 光是直直走的。
東西擋住光，後面就會有影子。
光可以穿過透明的東西，像玻璃，但穿不過不透明的東西，像木頭。
光離東西近，影子就比較大。
facts_en: Light travels in straight lines.
When something blocks the light, a shadow appears behind it.
Light goes through clear things like glass, but not through solid things like wood.
The closer the light is to the object, the bigger the shadow.
applies_to_en: needing a lamp to see at night

facts_zh: 光碰到亮亮光光的東西，會彈回來，這叫反射。
鏡子很光滑，會把光整齊地彈回來，所以我們看到自己。
白色的東西會把很多光彈回來，黑色的東西吸住比較多光。
我們看得到東西，是因為光從東西彈到我們的眼睛。
facts_en: When light hits a shiny thing, it bounces back. This is called reflection.
A mirror is very smooth, so it bounces the light back neatly and we see ourselves.
White things bounce back a lot of light. Black things take in more light.
We see things because light bounces off them into our eyes.
applies_to_en: dark clothes being hotter in summer

facts_zh: 太陽光看起來是白的，裡面其實藏著很多顏色。
光穿過小水珠的時候，顏色會分開，就變成彩虹。
下過雨、太陽出來的時候，最容易看到彩虹。
彩虹有紅、橙、黃、綠、藍、靛、紫。
facts_en: Sunlight looks white, but it has many colours hidden inside.
When light goes through tiny drops of water, the colours spread apart and make a rainbow.
Rainbows are easiest to see when the sun comes out after rain.
A rainbow has red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet.
applies_to_en: rainbows in a garden hose spray

principles.name_zh: 熱會從熱的地方跑到冷的地方
principles.name_en: Heat moves from hot to cold
facts_zh: 熱會從熱的東西跑到冷的東西。
熱湯放著，熱慢慢跑到空氣裡，就變涼了。
冰的東西放在外面，會吸走旁邊的熱，所以會慢慢變暖。
金屬很會傳熱，所以摸起來比木頭冰。
facts_en: Heat moves from a hot thing to a cooler thing.
Hot soup left out slowly gives its heat to the air, so it cools down.
A cold thing left out takes heat from around it, so it slowly gets warmer.
Metal passes heat quickly, so it feels colder than wood to touch.
applies_to_en: a spoon getting hot in soup
why we wear clothes in winter

facts_zh: 水變冷到夠冷，就會結成冰。
冰變暖了，就會融化成水。
很多東西，像巧克力和蠟燭，熱了也會變軟、融化。
facts_en: When water gets cold enough, it freezes into ice.
When ice gets warm, it melts into water.
Many things, like chocolate and candle wax, also soften and melt when they are warm.

facts_zh: 水變暖的時候，會變成看不見的水氣飛到空氣裡，這叫蒸發。
太陽曬、風吹，水乾得比較快。
水飛走了，水裡的東西像鹽，會留下來。
facts_en: When water gets warm, it turns into invisible water vapour and goes into the air. This is called evaporation.
Sun and wind make water dry faster.
When the water goes away, things in it, like salt, stay behind.

facts_zh: 空氣裡有看不見的水氣。
水氣碰到冰冷的東西，會變回小水滴，這叫凝結。
所以冰飲料的杯子外面會有水珠，冷天窗戶上也會起霧。
facts_en: The air has invisible water vapour in it.
When water vapour touches a cold thing, it turns back into tiny drops. This is called condensation.
That is why a cold drink glass gets wet outside and windows fog up on cold days.
applies_to_en: water drops on a cold drink

facts_zh: 太陽曬熱海、河和地上的水，水變成水氣飛到天上。
水氣在高高的天空變冷，變成很多小水滴，聚在一起就是雲。
雲裡的水滴變大變重，就會落下來變成雨。
雨流到河和海裡，水又會再旅行一次。
facts_en: The sun warms water in the sea, rivers and ground, and it rises as water vapour.
High in the sky it cools and turns into tiny drops that gather as clouds.
When the drops in a cloud get big and heavy, they fall as rain.
The rain flows to rivers and the sea, and the water travels again.

facts_zh: 固體有自己的形狀，像石頭和積木。
液體會流動，會變成杯子的形狀，像水和果汁。
氣體像空氣，看不見，會跑到每個地方。
同一種東西，冷熱不一樣，可能變成固體、液體或氣體，像冰、水和水氣。
facts_en: A solid keeps its own shape, like a rock or a block.
A liquid flows and takes the shape of its cup, like water or juice.
A gas, like air, is usually invisible and spreads everywhere.
The same thing can be a solid, liquid or gas depending on how hot it is, like ice, water and water vapour.

facts_zh: 空氣到處都有，雖然看不見。
空氣會佔位子，也有一點重量。
吹氣球的時候，空氣把氣球撐大。
我們和很多生物都需要空氣才能活。
facts_en: Air is everywhere, even though we cannot see it.
Air takes up space and has a little weight.
When you blow up a balloon, the air inside stretches it big.
We and many living things need air to live.
applies_to_en: an upside-down cup pushed into water

facts_zh: 風就是在動的空氣。
太陽把有的地方曬得比較熱，有的地方比較涼，空氣就會流動，變成風。
風可以吹動樹葉、風箏和帆船。
facts_en: Wind is air that is moving.
The sun warms some places more than others, and the air moves between warm and cool places. That makes wind.
Wind can move leaves, kites and sailboats.
applies_to_zh: 為什麼有時候風大有時候沒有風

facts_zh: 有些東西放進水裡會越變越小，混進水裡，看不見了，這叫溶解。
像糖和鹽會溶在水裡，沙子和石頭不會。
熱水通常讓糖溶得比較快。
溶進水裡的東西還在，只是變得很小很小。
facts_en: Some things, put in water, get smaller and mix in until we cannot see them. This is called dissolving.
Sugar and salt dissolve in water, but sand and stones do not.
Hot water usually dissolves sugar faster.
The dissolved stuff is still there, just in very tiny bits.

principles.name_en: Heating changes some things for good
facts_zh: 有些東西加熱以後，會變成不一樣的東西，不能再變回來。
生蛋煮熟後會變硬，麵糊烤了會變成蛋糕。
烤麵包或煎東西，顏色會變褐、味道會變香。
所以有些食物要煮熟，比較好吃也比較安全。
facts_en: Some things are changed by heat into something new, and they cannot change back.
A raw egg gets hard when cooked, and cake batter becomes cake when baked.
Toast and fried food turn brown and smell good when heated.
That is why some food needs cooking to taste good and be safe.

facts_zh: 不同的材料有不同的特性，像硬、軟、會彎、防水、透明。
人們會挑合適的材料來做東西。
橡膠防水又有彈性，所以做雨鞋和輪胎；金屬很硬又耐熱，所以做鍋子。
玻璃是透明的，所以用來做窗戶。
facts_en: Different materials have different properties, like hard, soft, bendy, waterproof or clear.
People pick the right material for each job.
Rubber is waterproof and stretchy, so it is used for rain boots and tyres. Metal is hard and handles heat, so it is used for pots.
Glass is clear, so it is used for windows.
applies_to_zh: 為什麼椅子是木頭做的
applies_to_en: why chairs are made of wood

facts_zh: 電要走一整圈的路（電路）才能讓燈亮、東西動。
開關可以把電路接起來或切斷。
電池可以把電送給小燈或小馬達。
電很危險，小朋友不可以玩插座。
facts_en: Electricity needs a full loop to travel around (a circuit) to light a lamp or make something work.
A switch closes or opens the loop.
A battery can send electricity to a small bulb or motor.
Electricity can be dangerous, so children should never play with sockets.

facts_zh: 兩個東西互相磨擦，有時候會帶一點靜電。
帶靜電的東西可以吸住小紙屑或頭髮。
天氣乾乾的時候，比較容易有靜電，碰到東西會啪一下。
facts_en: When two things rub together, they can get a little static electricity.
A thing with static can pull on small bits of paper or hair.
On dry days there is more static, so you may get a little zap when you touch something.
applies_to_en: a zap from a door handle
a balloon sticking to a wall
a plastic ruler picking up paper bits

facts_zh: 推或拉，可以讓東西動起來、停下來或轉彎。
用的力氣越大，東西動得越快、越遠。
重的東西比較難推動。
東西會一直動，直到有別的力讓它停下來。
facts_en: A push or a pull can make something start moving, stop or turn.
A bigger push makes it go faster and farther.
Heavy things are harder to get moving.
A moving thing keeps going until another force stops it.
applies_to_zh: 坐車突然煞車會往前倒
applies_to_en: lurching forward when a car brakes

facts_zh: 輪子在地上滾，比整個東西在地上拖更省力。
斜坡可以讓我們慢慢把東西推到高的地方，比較省力。
槓桿像蹺蹺板，可以用比較小的力氣撬起重的東西。
人們發明這些簡單的機器，讓工作變輕鬆。
facts_en: Wheels that roll make it easier to move something than dragging it along the ground.
A ramp lets us move a thing up slowly, which takes less effort.
A lever, like a seesaw, lets a small push lift something heavy.
People invented these simple machines to make work easier.

facts_zh: 地球繞著太陽走一大圈，要走一年。
地球是斜斜的，所以一年裡，不同的地方有時比較對著太陽，有時比較偏。
比較對著太陽時，白天長、天氣熱，是夏天；偏開時，白天短、天氣冷，是冬天。
春天和秋天是在中間。
facts_en: The Earth goes around the sun once in a year.
The Earth is tilted, so through the year a place sometimes leans toward the sun and sometimes away.
Leaning toward the sun means longer days and warm weather, which is summer. Leaning away means shorter days and cold weather, which is winter.
Spring and autumn are in between.

facts_zh: 地球像陀螺一樣，一天轉一圈。
對著太陽的那一面是白天，背著太陽的那一面是黑夜。
太陽沒有在走，是地球在轉，所以我們看起來太陽升起又落下。
地球的另一邊，白天的時候我們這裡是晚上。
facts_en: The Earth spins like a top, once a day.
The side facing the sun has day, and the side facing away has night.
The sun is not walking across the sky. The Earth is turning, so the sun seems to rise and set.
When it is day on one side of the Earth, it is night on the other side.
applies_to_en: why there is day and night
why it gets dark at night

facts_zh: 月亮自己不會發光，是反射太陽的光。
月亮繞著地球走，大約一個月繞一圈。
我們從地球看月亮，看到被太陽照亮的那一面的不同部分，所以有時圓、有時彎。
facts_en: The Moon does not make its own light. It reflects sunlight.
The Moon goes around the Earth, about once a month.
From Earth we see different parts of its sunny side, so it looks round sometimes and curved other times.
applies_to_zh: 月亮有時候圓有時候彎
applies_to_en: the Moon seeming to follow us
seeing the Moon in the day

facts_zh: 太陽是一顆星星，離我們比較近，所以看起來又大又亮。
夜空的星星是很遠很遠的太陽，所以看起來很小。
白天太陽太亮，所以我們看不到星星，但星星還在天上。
太陽是一大團很熱很熱、會發光的火球。
facts_en: The Sun is a star. It is closer to us, so it looks big and bright.
The stars at night are very, very far away suns, so they look tiny.
In the day the Sun is so bright that we cannot see the stars, but they are still there.
The Sun is a huge, very hot ball that gives off light.
applies_to_zh: 星星為什麼在晚上才看到
applies_to_en: why stars come out at night
why we see stars at night

principles.name_en: The Sun gives light and heat
facts_zh: 太陽給地球光和熱。
被太陽曬的地方會變暖，所以白天比晚上暖。
植物需要太陽光才能長大，我們也靠太陽的熱才能活。
曬太陽太久皮膚會被曬傷，所以要擦防曬或戴帽子。
facts_en: The Sun gives the Earth light and heat.
Places in the sunshine get warm, so daytime is warmer than night.
Plants need sunlight to grow, and we need the Sun's warmth to live.
Too much sun can burn the skin, so we use sunscreen or wear hats.

principles.name_zh: 太陽的位置和影子的變化
principles.name_en: The Sun's path and changing shadows
facts_zh: 我們看到太陽早上從東邊升起，中午在高高的天上，傍晚在西邊落下。
太陽的位置改變，影子也會改變。
太陽在高處，影子短；太陽在低處，影子長。
facts_en: We see the Sun rise in the east in the morning, high in the sky at noon, and set in the west in the evening.
When the Sun's place changes, shadows change too.
When the Sun is high, shadows are short. When it is low, shadows are long.
applies_to_en: long morning shadows and short noon shadows
the Sun rising in the east

facts_zh: 光跑得比聲音快很多。
打雷的時候，閃電和雷聲其實是一起發生的，但我們先看到光，後聽到聲音。
離雷越遠，雷聲越晚到。
閃電是雲裡跑出來的大電，打雷時要躲在室內。
facts_en: Light travels much faster than sound.
Lightning and thunder happen together, but we see the light first and hear the sound later.
The farther away the storm is, the later the thunder arrives.
Lightning is a big spark of electricity from clouds, so during a storm we stay indoors.
applies_to_zh: 看到煙火過一下才聽到聲音

facts_zh: 植物需要陽光、水和空氣才能長大。
植物的葉子用陽光、水和空氣自己做養分。
葉子裡有綠色的東西幫忙做養分，所以葉子是綠的。
植物沒有光，會長得瘦弱，葉子變黃。
facts_en: Plants need sunlight, water and air to grow.
A plant's leaves use sunlight, water and air to make their own food.
Leaves have a green part that helps make the food, which is why leaves are green.
A plant without light grows weak and its leaves turn yellow.

facts_zh: 根把植物固定在土裡，也吸水。
莖把水送到葉子，也撐住植物。
葉子做養分。
花會結果實和種子，有些花很香、顏色很漂亮，會吸引蜜蜂和蝴蝶。
facts_en: Roots hold the plant in the soil and take in water.
The stem carries water up to the leaves and holds the plant up.
Leaves make food.
Flowers make fruits and seeds. Some are bright and sweet-smelling to attract bees and butterflies.

facts_zh: 很多植物是從種子長出來的。
種子有水、暖暖的、有空氣，就會發芽。
芽長大變成幼苗，再變成大植物，大植物又會有新的種子。
水果裡面通常有種子，種子可以長成新的植物。
facts_en: Many plants grow from seeds.
A seed sprouts when it has water, warmth and air.
The sprout grows into a seedling and then a big plant, which makes new seeds.
Fruits usually have seeds inside, and the seeds can grow into new plants.
applies_to_zh: 秋天樹葉掉光了春天又長出來

principles.name_zh: 動物的身體適合牠的生活
facts_zh: 動物身體的樣子，剛好幫助牠們活下去。
長脖子可以吃到高高的樹葉，厚厚的毛或脂肪可以保暖，翅膀可以飛。
有些動物顏色像周圍，可以躲起來不被發現（保護色）。
不同地方的動物，身體也不一樣，像沙漠的駱駝和北極的熊。
facts_en: An animal's body is shaped in a way that helps it live.
A long neck can reach tall leaves, thick fur or fat keeps an animal warm, and wings let it fly.
Some animals have colours like their surroundings so they can hide (camouflage).
Animals in different places have different bodies, like camels in the desert and bears in the Arctic.

facts_zh: 動物需要食物、水、空氣和安全的地方住。
動物住的地方叫棲地，像森林、海洋、沙漠。
有些動物冬天會睡長長的覺（冬眠）或搬到暖和的地方，因為冬天食物少。
有些動物晚上才出來找吃的，白天休息。
facts_en: Animals need food, water, air and a safe place to live.
The place an animal lives is its habitat, like a forest, ocean or desert.
Some animals sleep a long time in winter (hibernate) or move to warmer places because food is scarce.
Some animals come out at night to find food and rest in the day.

facts_zh: 動物會生寶寶，寶寶會長大，長大後又會生新的寶寶。
有的動物從蛋裡出來，像雞和青蛙；有的動物直接生寶寶，像貓和狗。
毛毛蟲會變成蛹，再變成蝴蝶。
動物媽媽或爸爸常常會照顧寶寶。
facts_en: Animals have babies, the babies grow up, and then they have babies of their own.
Some animals hatch from eggs, like chickens and frogs. Others are born alive, like cats and dogs.
A caterpillar becomes a chrysalis, then a butterfly.
Animal parents often look after their babies.
applies_to_zh: 小動物為什麼長得不一樣

facts_zh: 植物自己做養分。
有的動物吃植物，有的動物吃別的動物。
一個吃一個，就連成一條食物鏈。
動物吃東西，是為了得到力氣和長大。
facts_en: Plants make their own food.
Some animals eat plants, and some animals eat other animals.
When one eats another, we get a food chain.
Animals eat to get energy and to grow.

principles.name_en: What living things have in common
facts_zh: 生物會長大，需要水和食物或養分，也需要空氣。
生物會生寶寶，也會死亡。
石頭和玩具不是生物，因為牠們不會吃東西，也不會長大。
facts_en: Living things grow, and need water, food or nutrients, and air.
Living things have babies, and they also die.
Rocks and toys are not alive, because they do not eat or grow.

facts_zh: 我們用眼睛看、耳朵聽、鼻子聞、舌頭嘗、皮膚摸。
眼睛看到光，耳朵聽到聲音，這些訊息會送到腦袋。
腦袋會告訴我們那是什麼，也會讓我們感覺到冷、熱和痛。
鼻子和舌頭一起，我們才嘗得出食物的味道。
facts_en: We see with our eyes, hear with our ears, smell with our nose, taste with our tongue and feel with our skin.
Our eyes catch light and our ears catch sound, and they send messages to the brain.
The brain tells us what it is, and lets us feel cold, hot and pain.
Nose and tongue work together so we can taste food.
applies_to_zh: 為什麼眼睛閉起來就看不到
applies_to_en: food tasting bland with a cold
pulling your hand from something hot
why we cannot see with closed eyes

facts_zh: 我們吸進空氣，空氣裡有身體需要的氧氣。
心臟像一個小幫浦，把血送到全身。
跑步或玩得很用力時，身體需要更多氧氣，所以我們會喘、心跳也會變快。
休息的時候，呼吸和心跳會慢下來。
facts_en: We breathe in air, which has oxygen our body needs.
The heart is like a small pump that sends blood around the body.
When we run or play hard, the body needs more oxygen, so we pant and the heart beats faster.
When we rest, breathing and heartbeat slow down.

facts_zh: 食物給身體力氣，也讓我們長大。
食物在嘴巴被嚼碎，再到肚子裡，慢慢被分解，身體拿走有用的部分。
沒用的部分變成大便和小便，離開身體。
肚子空空的時候，身體會告訴我們：我餓了。
facts_en: Food gives the body energy and helps us grow.
Food is chewed in the mouth, goes to the tummy and is broken down, and the body takes what it needs.
What is left over leaves the body as poo and wee.
When the tummy is empty, the body tells us we are hungry.
applies_to_en: tummy ache from eating too much

facts_zh: 有很小很小、眼睛看不到的壞蟲蟲，叫細菌和病毒，有些會讓我們生病。
用肥皂和水洗手，可以把手上的細菌洗掉。
吃東西前、上廁所後要洗手。
咳嗽或打噴嚏時用手肘或衛生紙遮住嘴巴，細菌才不會跑到別人身上。
facts_en: There are tiny, tiny germs we cannot see, and some of them can make us sick.
Washing hands with soap and water washes germs off.
We wash before eating and after using the toilet.
Cover coughs and sneezes with an elbow or tissue so germs do not reach other people.

facts_zh: 牙齒幫我們咬和嚼食物。
食物殘渣會留在牙齒上，細菌愛吃它，會把牙齒弄出洞，就是蛀牙。
每天刷牙，可以把食物渣和細菌刷掉。
小朋友的乳牙會掉，新的大牙會長出來，大牙掉了不會再長。
facts_en: Teeth help us bite and chew food.
Bits of food stay on teeth, and germs eat them and make holes in the teeth, which we call cavities.
Brushing every day cleans away the food bits and germs.
Children's baby teeth fall out and new big teeth grow in, but big teeth do not grow back.

facts_zh: 皮膚受傷流血，血會慢慢變乾變硬，蓋住傷口，這是痂。
痂像天然的小繃帶，保護下面長出新的皮膚。
新皮長好了，痂就會自己掉下來。
不要一直摳痂，傷口才會好得比較快。
facts_en: When skin is cut and bleeds, the blood slowly dries and hardens over the cut. This is a scab.
A scab is like a natural little bandage that protects new skin growing underneath.
When the new skin is ready, the scab falls off by itself.
Do not pick at a scab, so the cut heals faster.

facts_zh: 身體用了力氣會累，睡覺的時候身體可以休息和長大。
睡得夠，白天比較有精神，也比較能專心。
運動讓肌肉和心臟變強壯。
吃得好、睡得好、多運動，身體比較健康。
facts_en: The body gets tired from using energy, and sleep lets it rest and grow.
Enough sleep means more energy and better focus in the day.
Exercise makes muscles and the heart stronger.
Eating well, sleeping well and moving a lot help the body stay healthy.
applies_to_zh: 為什麼睡醒會想上廁所
applies_to_en: why we feel hungry in the morning
why we need meals and sleep

facts_zh: 岩石有大有小，有硬有軟。
風、水和冰會把大岩石慢慢磨碎，變成小石頭、沙和土。
這要很久很久的時間。
土裡有小小的石頭碎片和死掉的葉子，所以植物可以在裡面長大。
facts_en: Rocks come in many sizes, and some are hard and some are soft.
Wind, water and ice slowly wear big rocks into small stones, sand and soil.
This takes a very, very long time.
Soil has tiny rock bits and bits of dead leaves, so plants can grow in it.

principles.name_en: Oceans, salt water and fresh water
facts_zh: 地球上大部分的水在海裡。
海水是鹹的，因為水流過岩石和土時，帶走一點鹽，一直流到海裡。
海水曬乾（蒸發）後，鹽會留下來。
海水不能直接喝；河水和湖水是淡水，要乾淨才能喝。
facts_en: Most of the water on Earth is in the sea.
Seawater is salty because water flowing over rocks and soil picks up a little salt and carries it to the sea.
When seawater dries up (evaporates), the salt stays behind.
We cannot drink seawater. Rivers and lakes have fresh water, which needs to be clean to drink.

facts_zh: 地球的表面是一大片一大片的岩石，很慢很慢地在動。
岩石碰在一起或滑動時，地面會搖，這就是地震。
地球裡面很深的地方很熱，岩石會熔化成滾燙的熔岩，火山噴發時，熔岩會跑出來。
地震時要躲在桌子下，保護頭部。
facts_en: The Earth's surface is made of huge pieces of rock that move very, very slowly.
When the rock pieces bump or slide, the ground shakes. That is an earthquake.
Deep inside the Earth it is very hot and rock melts into hot lava, which comes out when a volcano erupts.
In an earthquake, get under a sturdy table and protect your head.

principles.name_en: Recycling and caring for the Earth
facts_zh: 很多東西是用地球上的資源做的，像水、樹和石油，用完就沒有了。
垃圾分類和回收，可以把紙、塑膠、玻璃再做成新的東西。
少用、重複使用和回收，可以讓垃圾變少，也保護動物和環境。
垃圾不能亂丟。
facts_en: Many things are made from the Earth's resources, like water, trees and oil, and they can run out.
Sorting and recycling lets paper, plastic and glass be made into new things.
Using less, reusing and recycling make less rubbish and help animals and nature.
Rubbish must not be thrown on the ground.

facts_zh: 火要有東西燒、空氣和熱，才會燒起來。
沒有空氣，火就會熄掉，像蠟燭蓋上杯子。
水可以讓火熄掉。
火很燙很危險，小朋友不可以玩火。
facts_en: A fire needs something to burn, air and heat.
Without air a fire goes out, like a candle under a glass.
Water can put a fire out.
Fire is hot and dangerous, so children must not play with it.
applies_to_en: putting out a fire with water

facts_zh: 食物放久了，細菌和黴菌會長在上面，食物就會壞掉。
天氣熱的時候，細菌長得比較快。
冰箱很冷，細菌長得很慢，食物可以放比較久。
壞掉的食物會讓人肚子痛，不可以吃。
facts_en: Food left for a long time grows germs and mould, and goes bad.
Germs grow faster when it is warm.
A fridge is cold, so germs grow slowly and food lasts longer.
Bad food can give us a tummy ache, so we must not eat it.

principles.name_en: People make tools to solve problems
facts_zh: 人們遇到困難，會想辦法發明工具來幫忙。
不同的工具有不同的功能，像剪刀剪東西、時鐘告訴我們時間。
有些工具需要用電，有些要用手。
工具要用得安全。
facts_en: When people have a problem, they invent tools to help.
Different tools do different jobs. Scissors cut, and a clock tells the time.
Some tools need electricity, and some are used by hand.
Tools must be used safely.
